votes.motion: Nominate Comm. Tyler as Chair of the Cemetery Commission
votes.quote: comm. mendoza made a motion to nominate comm. tyler to chair the cemetery commission. motion was seconded by comm. tyler and voted unanimously to appoint comm. tyler

votes.motion: Adjourn
votes.quote: a motion was made by chairman tyler to adjourn, seconded by comm. mendoza

votes.motion: Appropriate $15,000.00 from the Sale of Lots account for FY22 operating expenses
votes.quote: a motion was made by commissioner yasko to appropriate the sum of $15,000.00 from the sale of lots account at this spring's atm. it was duly seconded by commissioner mendoza, and a roll call vote was unanimous

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting
votes.quote: a motion was made to adjourn, duly seconded and by roll call vote was voted to adjourn at 4:50 pm.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the February 18, 2021 meeting.
votes.quote: the minutes were read and with no additions or corrections, were approved unanimously.

votes.motion: Pay two vouchers: $14,423.93 for the final garage billing (FY 21 appropriation) and $512.00 for the new cemetery department sign (gift account).
votes.quote: come from our gift account, was duly motioned to pay, and voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting at 7:22 pm.
votes.quote: motion to adjourn was made, duly seconded and with no further discussion, meeting was adjourned at 7:22 pm.

votes.motion: Re-organize the board: elect William Tyler as Chairman, Nancy Foss-Yasko as Vice Chairman, and David Dorren as Clerk.
votes.quote: after a roll call vote, all seats were voted unanimously in favor .

votes.motion: Accept the minutes of the April 22, 2021 meeting as written.
votes.quote: a motion was made and duly seconded to accept the minutes as written. a roll call voted in favor unanimously.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting.
votes.quote: a motion was made and duly seconded to adjourn and by roll call vote was affirmative.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the May 20, 2021 board meeting.
votes.quote: minutes of the may 20, 2021 board meeting were read and approved by commissioners yasko, dorren and chairman tyler.

votes.motion: Approve the vouchers presented for payment.
votes.quote: the vouchers were voted on, signed and approved by chairman tyler, commissioners yasko and dorren.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting.
votes.quote: motion was made to adjourn the meeting and was seconded and affirmed by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Keep the North Cemetery parking lot closed during the winter months.
votes.quote: a 3-0 vote was taken to keep the cemetery closed during the winter.

votes.motion: Approve the corrected minutes of the June 24, 2021 board meeting.
votes.quote: corrected minutes of the june 24,2021 board meeting were read and approved by commissioners yasko, dorren and chairman tyler.

votes.motion: Install a camera on the Cemetery Garage facing the last entrance on Holman Street, as suggested by Chairman Tyler.
votes.quote: chairman tyler and commissioners yasko and dorren approved.

votes.motion: Place the Lance May commemorative plaque on the right pillar of the Garage.
votes.quote: chairman tyler and commissioners yasko and dorren voted to have the place placed on the right pillar of the garage.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting.
votes.quote: motion was made to adjourn the meeting and was seconded and affirmed by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of August 5, 2021 and September 3, 2021.
votes.quote: motion to approve minutes from august 5, 2021 and september 3, 2021 approved and passed by chairman tyler and commissioners yasko and dorren.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting.
votes.quote: motion to adjourn the meeting and was seconded and affirmed by roll call vote.

meetings.ours_headline: Cemetery Commission held burial and lot fees steady, hired flower care, and approved up to $200 for dump-deterrent cameras.

votes.motion: Send an email or letter to DPW Rob Oliva thanking him and his department for their work on the Cemeteries this year.
votes.quote: motion to approve 3-0

votes.motion: Accept the minutes of October 20, 2021.
votes.quote: motion to accept minutes approved 3-0

votes.motion: Not to increase (raise) Burial Rates for Lunenburg.
votes.quote: motion to not to raise burial rates approved 3-0.

votes.motion: Accept the arrangements for planting flowers at the North and South Cemetery entrances in 2022, including Helen Balcom's watering invoice of $575 for the year.
votes.quote: motion to accept 3-0.

votes.motion: Postpone the Rainmaker update until the next meeting.
votes.quote: motioned carried 3-0

votes.motion: Buy back cemetery lots 778-1 and 778-2 at the North Cemetery for $250.
votes.quote: motion to buy back approved by vote 3-0

votes.motion: Approve the purchase of two motion-activated, battery-operated cameras, one for the North Cemetery and one for the South Cemetery.
votes.quote: motion was made to approve the cameras by vote of 3-0

votes.motion: Post the Cemetery Regulations, Information and No Dumping Policies on Facebook and other social media.
votes.quote: motion accepted 3-0.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting at 7:25pm.
votes.quote: motion to adjourn at 7:25pm accepted 3-0
